refText: Hey, how's it going? So, yesterday I went downtown to run a few errands, and honestly it was a total mess. But after that I grabbed a coffee with a friend, we talked for a good while, and it all went away. What did you do this weekend? Come on, tell me, I want to know.
instruct: A woman in her early thirties from the United States with a General American accent. Warm, friendly and clear, conversational pace, close to the microphone, studio quality.
